_: Overlay effects (assets/effects/): short clips keyed onto the picture under the captions (lib/assemble/ffmpeg.js). type overlay = the pipeline places it itself (rewind after a teaser, fastforward on sped-up travel, swoosh on the lift to the cake); type sting = the planner may call for it in doc.json (segment "stings": [{ "id", "at_sec" }]) when its `use` fits the moment. key: black (colorkey) or green (chromakey, with the colour and strength that cut this clip cleanly). layout full = stretched to the frame; centre = scaled to `scale` of the frame width, centred. sound mix = on the game bus; takeover = the music drops to a whisper while it plays and it is heard at `gain_db`; none. in/out are seconds inside the file.

swoosh.note: built in (a white flash and a rush of air) until Tabor supplies a clip; a file here replaces it

troll-face.use: TO FILL IN (Tabor): when a player gets trolled, baited into a trap, or killed from behind by someone they trusted; the blue troll face with its own sound takes over the music for its eight seconds
